title: Payment Chargeback Dispute
core_conflict: An automated risk system flags a high-value transaction as fraudulent and recommends blocking the merchant account immediately due to suspicious proxy usage. However, visual geolocational map telemetry charts and customer support chat transcripts from later rounds prove the transaction was a legitimate purchase during the customer's international vacation, requiring the risk analyst to override the automated block and allowlist the transaction signature.
required_constraints: Blair Fraud Investigator flags the transaction as fraud and blocks the merchant. Devon Merchant Owner demands immediate allowlist action.
The coordinator must visually inspect 'flight_schedule.png' to extract the layover flight number ('LH-2401') and 'customer_login_map.png' to verify the Paris airport coordinate pin.
Casey Support Specialist requires the layover flight number to sign the passport verification. The coordinator must provide the flight number in the chat to receive Casey's signing key.

Avery Risk Analyst will execute the transaction allowlist override only after the signed payload file '/signed_override.json' (generated by running '/scripts/sign_payload.py --key <key> --flight-id LH-2401') is written to the workspace.
